preconditions.description: The input n must be an integer.

postconditions.description: If n is 0 or negative, the function returns an empty string.

postconditions.expression: n > 0 and return_value == '\n'.join(''.join(str(x) for x in range(n, i, -1)) for i in range(n-1, -1, -1))
postconditions.description: If n is positive, the function returns a string representing the pattern with n rows.
